mechanism: Sacubitril (ARNI) may potentiate risperidone's hypotensive effects and both drugs have potential for orthostasis; risperidone is metabolized by CYP3A4/2D6 with minimal direct interaction but additive CNS/cardiovascular effects are clinically relevant.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for orthostatic hypotension and syncope risk; use lowest effective risperidone dose; educate patient on position changes and fall prevention.
